policies.description: All mandatory fields required by the tool (group_id and user_id) must be present and validated before invoking add_new_group_member.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: The group and user referenced by group_id and user_id must be verified to exist before adding the membership.
references: First you must check the user information and operate exclusively based on confirmed user roles, verified record relationships, and ITIL/database integrity rules.

policies.description: The operation must be halted if the user is already a member of the specified group.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints. Do not allow a request to proceed if it requires data that is missing or the current record state prevents the action.

policies.policy_name: Role‑Based Permission for Group Membership Changes
policies.description: Only roles with full CRUD access across all tables (e.g., Administrator) are authorized to create a new group member record.
references: Administrator (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables.

policies.description: Do not fabricate or assume IDs; rely solely on verified API results when referencing group_id and user_id.
references: Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results.

policies.description: add_new_group_member must be executed as a single validated operation; if any prerequisite data is missing or invalid, the operation must be stopped.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints. Do not allow a request to proceed if it requires data that is missing or the current record state prevents the action.

policies.description: Before adding a user to a group, ensure that the group and the user exist within the same organizational context and that the relationship between them is valid, complying with the requirement to operate exclusively on verified record relationships.
references: First you must check the user information and operate exclusively based on confirmed user roles, verified record relationships, and ITIL/database integrity rules.

policies.description: If the add_new_group_member request exceeds the service's rate limits, the operation must be paused and retried using exponential backoff rather than proceeding immediately.
references: Rate Limiting: If exceeded, pause and retry using Exponential Backoff.

policies.description: If the invoking user's role does not have sufficient authority to create a group membership (e.g., non‑Administrator roles), the operation must be halted and a 403 Forbidden response returned.
references: 403 Forbidden: Permission denied (user role lacks authority for the operation).

policies.description: If the user is already a member of the specified group, the add_new_group_member operation must be halted and a 409 Conflict response returned, indicating a state conflict.
references: 409 Conflict: Record locking or state conflict.

policies.policy_name: Active User Requirement for Group Membership
policies.description: Before adding a user to a group, verify that the user’s account is active (users.active = true). If the user is inactive, the operation must be stopped.
references: User Status: Ensure any user being assigned to (assigned_to) or updated is users.active = true.
